exclusions: model weight files and Ollama blob store: reacquire using pinned model revisions/digests; access requirements still apply
index arrays and chunk caches: rebuild from archived prepared corpora, source/config snapshots and pinned assets
original downloaded native dataset JSON: prepared corpora/questions are included; source hashes/revisions remain pinned
unrelated pilot/smoke attempts not explicitly listed; original workspace retains them
current uncommitted archive implementation: measurement source snapshots come from recorded Git revisions; commit the archiver separately
validation_commands: python -m ragbench_lab study-archive configs/stage-a-study.toml --specification configs/archive-protocol.json --output NEW_ARCHIVE.zip
invariants: stream and fully exhaust every recorded hash chain; reject incomplete JSONL tails, duplicates and mixed run identities
compare exact request-key sets, all three repetitions, source/condition/native/cache/context/resource controls and validation links
primary runs are complete failure-free first attempts; historical incomplete runs and failures stay separate and visible
verify prepared hashes/splits and source snapshots against recorded source-tree fingerprints
project-relative explicit inputs only; reject traversal, symlinks, missing inputs and existing archive output
stream ZIP copies and verify every member against inventory SHA-256; preserve any failed output for review
do not mutate records, launch models, tune on held-out quality, or claim this archive includes model weights
